market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a fringe political activist with negligible national recognition. The 2026 Brazilian presidential race is expected to be dominated by heavyweights like Lula (if running) or Tarcísio, and no credible scenario places Santos near second place. His true probability is far below the market’s 5.5%.
evidence_points: Santos has never been elected to any major office and lost the 2024 São Paulo mayoral race.
No national poll currently includes him among serious contenders for the presidency.
Brazilian elections historically require strong party backing or celebrity status, neither of which Santos possesses.
sources_consulted: Recent news coverage of 2026 presidential speculation
